name: RedlineRevisionText
job: A sentence that edits itself in front of the visitor with proofreader marks: old words struck out, better words inserted in a second ink
visitor_action: none (plays in view); hover replays the edit; replays on re-entering the viewport
owner_settings: Sentence with edits (text, optional replacement word)
mobile: same, edits happen one at a time
motion: strike draws across old word, caret springs up, new word writes in, then the margin note (reduced-motion: final edited sentence with marks visible)

checks.render: pass (1 fix used: preview grid column, long-text type scaling, caret depth)

provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Copy desk: bright white galley paper, graphite type, vermilion strike lines, ink-blue insertions in a handwriting face with caret marks
notes: Handwriting relies on system fonts (Bradley Hand / Segoe Print), so on Android it falls back to a generic cursive; a replacement much longer than its old word leaves a wide gap in the line. 2026-11-23: removed on-screen hint/replay per contract §2 rule
